en.title: Turn a short order into JSON without an account
en.summary: We tested a two-turn text task in Duck.ai: structure an order, then change the quantity while keeping the unit price. The chat opened and returned both answers without requiring an account.
en.input: Return valid JSON for a notebook order: quantity 3, unit_price_usd 4.50, total_usd.
steps: Open Duck.ai and enter the sample in the chat box. In this test the selected model was GPT-6 Luna; the available models may change.
Submit the prompt. Check that the response contains quantity, unit_price_usd and total_usd.
Send the follow-up: “Change quantity to 4 and recalculate the total. Return valid JSON only.”
Use the response copy button to copy the JSON. The captured clipboard output parsed successfully.
en.result: The first response gave total_usd 13.50. The follow-up retained unit_price_usd 4.50 and returned quantity 4 with total_usd 18.00. Both responses used JSON syntax, and the second answer preserved the earlier context.
en.limitations: This was a small text and arithmetic task, not a general accuracy benchmark. Model output can be wrong. Duck.ai sends chats to remote model providers through DuckDuckGo; it is not an offline or local-inference tool. Copying was verified; file export and attachment handling were not tested.

screenshot.alt: Duck.ai returns quantity 4, unit_price_usd 4.50 and total_usd 18.00 for the follow-up prompt.

sources.label: DuckDuckGo: information shared with model providers

提交问题，检查回答是否包含 quantity、unit_price_usd 和 total_usd。
继续输入：“Change quantity to 4 and recalculate the total. Return valid JSON only.”
点击回答旁的复制按钮，复制 JSON。本次捕获的剪贴板内容通过了 JSON 解析检查。
zh.result: 第一轮回答的总价为 13.50。第二轮保留了 4.50 的单价，将数量改为 4，总价更新为 18.00。两次回答都使用 JSON 语法，第二次回答也保留了上文的订单信息。
zh.limitations: 这次只测试了简短的文字与算术任务，不能代表模型的整体准确率。模型仍可能出错。Duck.ai 经由 DuckDuckGo 将对话发送给远程模型服务商，并非离线或本地推理工具。本次验证了复制功能，未测试文件导出和附件处理。

en.title: Look up a public IP and export its report
en.summary: BrowserLeaks exposes several different kinds of information. We tested its public IP lookup, then opened the Canvas and JavaScript reports to distinguish network lookup results from browser capability measurements.
steps: Enter 1.1.1.1 in the IP Address Lookup field and submit it.
Inspect the hostname, network ASN and registry sections. The lookup result is also available at /ip/1.1.1.1.
Use the camera icon beside the report heading to download the page as a PNG. Open the file and check both the text tables and the map.
en.result: The report identified one.one.one.one and AS13335 / Cloudflare, with APNIC registry data. The exported PNG was 950×1950 pixels and preserved the text tables. Some external map tiles in the downloaded image showed 403 access-blocked panels, although the in-page map rendered normally.
en.limitations: This example uses a public resolver address, not a personal IP. Database geolocation can be misleading for anycast services. Browser fingerprint reports can identify a device; the tests diagnose exposure but do not prevent tracking. The suite includes remote lookups and should not be described as entirely local.

screenshot.alt: PairDrop displays a received 55-byte JSON file and a Save again button.

en.title: Transfer a small JSON file between browser peers
en.summary: We used two tabs in one browser, joined the same temporary room, and sent a small file in both directions without creating an account.
steps: Open PairDrop in both test tabs. If the other tab is not listed, create a temporary room and enter its room code in the second tab.
Match the displayed peer names before selecting a recipient. We used Aqua Crawdad and Sapphire Dormouse.
Choose the JSON file on the sending tab. On the receiving tab, accept the request and select Save.
Compare the downloaded file with the source. We also sent the downloaded file back and tested Save on the original tab.
en.result: The 55-byte JSON arrived with its content intact. A byte-for-byte comparison of the first download and original file found no difference. Neither send, receive nor download required an account.
en.limitations: This is a same-browser, small-file test. It does not establish cross-device or cross-network reliability. Room discovery uses a remote service; we did not verify the file transport or server retention. Share room codes only with intended recipients and check the sender name before accepting.

screenshot.alt: PairDrop 显示已收到 55 字节的 JSON 文件，并提供再次保存按钮。

zh.title: 在浏览器节点间传送 JSON 小文件
zh.summary: 我们在同一浏览器中打开两个标签页，加入同一个临时房间，并完成双向文件传输，全程无需注册账号。
steps: 在两个测试标签页中打开 PairDrop。若看不到对端，创建临时房间，并在另一标签页输入房间号。
选择收件人之前核对设备名称。本次两个节点分别为 Aqua Crawdad 和 Sapphire Dormouse。
在发送端选择 JSON 文件；接收端确认请求后，点击保存。
将下载文件与原文件比较。我们还把下载文件反向发送，并在原标签页验证了保存功能。
zh.result: 55 字节的 JSON 完整送达。首次下载文件与原文件逐字节比较，没有发现差异。发送、接收和下载均未要求账号。
zh.limitations: 这次仅验证了同一浏览器内的小文件传输，不能代表跨设备或跨网络可靠性。房间发现依赖远程服务；我们没有确认文件传输路径或服务端保留策略。房间号应只分享给预期收件人，接收前需核对发送端名称。

screenshot.alt: CyberChef shows the To Base64 recipe, nologin.tools input and the encoded output.

en.title: Encode text as Base64 and check the round trip
en.summary: We built a short CyberChef recipe, saved its output, then added a decoding step to check that the original text returned.
steps: Double-click To Base64 in Operations to add it to the recipe.
Enter nologin.tools in Input and run Bake, or leave Auto Bake enabled.
Use the Output save button, enter a filename, and download the text file.
Add From Base64 after To Base64. The output should return to the original text.
en.result: The encoded result was bm9sb2dpbi50b29scw==. The downloaded file contained exactly that string. Adding From Base64 returned nologin.tools, without an account prompt.
en.limitations: Base64 is encoding, not encryption. This small UTF-8 text test does not verify every recipe, large files, or operations that intentionally make network requests.

screenshot.alt: CyberChef 显示 To Base64 配方、nologin.tools 输入和对应的编码输出。

zh.title: 把文字转成 Base64，并验证往返还原
zh.summary: 我们搭建了一个简短的 CyberChef 配方，保存输出文件，再增加解码步骤，检查是否能还原原文。
steps: 在 Operations 中双击 To Base64，将其加入配方。
在 Input 中输入 nologin.tools，点击 Bake，或保持 Auto Bake 开启。
点击 Output 的保存按钮，输入文件名并下载文本文件。
在 To Base64 后增加 From Base64，检查输出是否还原为原文。
zh.result: 编码结果为 bm9sb2dpbi50b29scw==，下载文件与该字符串完全一致。增加 From Base64 后，输出还原为 nologin.tools，全程未要求账号。
zh.limitations: Base64 是编码，不是加密。本次仅测试一段 UTF-8 短文本，不能代表全部配方、大文件性能或主动访问网络的操作。

en.title: Find ticket IDs and export the matches as JSON
en.summary: We tested a small regular expression against two valid ticket IDs and one invalid lookalike, then copied the match export.

Wait for the match result; the default PCRE2 flavor and gm flags were used.

steps: Use File → Load from Computer to open the WAV fixture.
